story.summaryEn:
Good points this weekend. Wasn’t quite enough today, but we’ll try again in two weeks in Austin. 
Thank you very much for the big support here in Singapore ❤️
detailZh:
这个周末表现不错。今天还不够，但两周后我们将在奥斯汀再次尝试。
非常感谢在这里新加坡的巨大支持 ❤️
